recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-18427 unless a future work group decision changes the documented or exploratory status of resource representations.
issue_request: FHIR-18427 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core formats-page correction from the STU3 ballot. It asked not to claim that the specification "documents the following formats" for formats still under consideration, and the accepted resolution was to reword the sentence as "documents (or is exploring documenting) the following formats".
initial_application: The Jira comment cites GH#311fc101. In this source history, commit 861249d43393a02ee747030e3fef135210d87b59 ("GF#18427") applied the requested wording to source/formats.html by changing "documents the following formats" to "documents (or is exploring documenting) the following formats".
additional_context: Later formats-page work moved the exchange-format content from source/formats.html to the active source/resource-formats.html page. The active hierarchy lists formats.html, resource-formats.html, XML, JSON, NDJSON, and RDF under Resource Definitions. Current source/resource-formats.html says the specification defines JSON, XML, and RDF for exchanged resources, separately notes that Bulk Data Formats are undergoing exploration, and states that other representations are allowed but not described by this specification.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The stale overbroad sentence is absent from the current active formats sources, and the current resource formats page already conveys the distinction FHIR-18427 requested without adding redundant prose.

related_jiras.note: Later Published formats-page work split the resource formats content into source/resource-formats.html, which is now the active page carrying the relevant wording.
